description: Read what happened to the events sent to the agent (mba_send_agent_event) over a date range, one row per event type, busiest first: how many were received, how many the agent successfully processed, and the mean end-to-end latency. Successfully processed means the agent sent its message, not that the message was delivered. Figures are rolled up once a day, so the most recent day may still be incomplete. Known limitation: the dates are in PACIFIC TIME, not the business time zone, and the range may span at most 30 days, counting both ends.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

event_type.description: Return only this event type, named as it was sent. Omit for every event type.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Inclusive.

name: mba_get_agent_event_insights

outputSchema.description: The agent event insights for the requested range

avg_e2e_latency_ms.description: Mean time in milliseconds from receiving an event to the agent finishing with it, across every event type in the range. Null when nothing ran end to end

data.description: One row per event type received in the range, busiest first. Empty when no event of yours was received

items.description: Volume, completion, and latency for a single agent event type

avg_e2e_latency_ms.description: Mean time in milliseconds from receiving one of these events to the agent finishing with it, over every request in the range that ran end to end. Null when none did

event_type.description: The event type these figures cover, exactly as you sent it in the agent event request

received.description: Requests of this event type that arrived over the range, counted once each and summed across days

successfully_processed.description: Requests of this event type the agent finished handling, summed across days. Requests that were turned away, skipped, or failed are not counted here. Finishing means the agent sent its message; it is not a delivery signal, and does not guarantee the message reached the customer device

title: Read agent event insights
